app.title: Windows Loudness Equalization, reverse-engineered and ported to PipeWire
app.description: A PipeWire module implementing Windows loudness equalization, reverse‑engineered from the WinMM audio driver.
proposed_tests: Play a test WAV file and capture output latency
Compare perceived loudness before and after module
Measure CPU usage of the module on a 10‑second clip
